     3	
     4	
     5	import sys
     6	
     7	from textworld import Agent
     8	
     9	prompt_toolkit_available = False
    10	try:
    11	    # For command line history and autocompletion.
    12	    from prompt_toolkit import prompt
    13	    from prompt_toolkit.completion import WordCompleter
    14	    from prompt_toolkit.history import InMemoryHistory
    15	    prompt_toolkit_available = sys.stdout.isatty()
    16	except ImportError:
    17	    pass
    18	
    19	try:
    20	    # For command line history when prompt_toolkit is not available.
    21	    import readline  # noqa: F401
    22	except ImportError:
    23	    pass
    24	
    25	
    26	class HumanAgent(Agent):
    27	    def __init__(self, autocompletion=True, oracle=False):
    28	        self.autocompletion = autocompletion
    29	        self.oracle = oracle
    30	
    31	        self._history = None
    32	        if prompt_toolkit_available:
    33	            self._history = InMemoryHistory()
    34	
    35	    def reset(self, env):
    36	        # Commands typed by the player are already displayed.
    37	        env.display_command_during_render = False
    38	
    39	        if self.autocompletion:
    40	            env.request_infos.admissible_commands = True
    41	
    42	        if self.oracle:
    43	            env.request_infos.policy_commands = True
    44	            env.request_infos.intermediate_reward = True
    45	
    46	    def act(self, game_state, reward, done):
    47	        if (self.oracle and game_state["policy_commands"] and not done):
    48	            text = '[{score}/{max_score}|({intermediate_score}): {policy}]\n'.format(
    49	                score=game_state["score"],
    50	                max_score=game_state["max_score"],
    51	                intermediate_score=game_state["intermediate_reward"],
    52	                policy=" > ".join(game_state["policy_commands"])
    53	            )
    54	            print("Oracle: {}\n".format(text))
    55	
    56	        if prompt_toolkit_available:
    57	            actions_completer = None
    58	            if self.autocompletion and game_state["admissible_commands"]:
    59	                actions_completer = WordCompleter(game_state["admissible_commands"],
    60	                                                  ignore_case=True, sentence=True)
    61	            action = prompt('> ', completer=actions_completer,
    62	                            history=self._history, enable_history_search=True)
    63	        else:
    64	            if self.autocompletion and game_state["admissible_commands"]:
    65	                print("Available actions: {}\n".format(game_state["admissible_commands"]))
    66	
    67	            action = input('> ')
    68	
    69	        return action
